svg.font-family: Amazon Ember, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: CI/CD for AWS container services: deployment pipeline. 1. A developer starts deploy.yml by hand (workflow_dispatch). 2. Each job assumes GitHubActions_ECS_Role through OIDC, so no AWS keys are stored. 3. Build and push: Docker builds the image, tags it with the commit SHA and pushes it to ECR. 4. Terraform plan receives that image URL. 5. Terraform apply, in the production environment, registers a new task definition and updates the service. 6. Fargate pulls the commit-SHA-tagged image from ECR. Plan and apply keep Terraform state in an S3 backend. A separate destroy workflow removes everything after a typed confirmation.
svg.text: A developer starts deploy.yml by hand (workflow_dispatch).
Each job assumes GitHubActions_ECS_Role through OIDC, so no AWS keys are stored.
Build and push: Docker builds the image, tags it with the commit SHA and pushes it to ECR.
Terraform plan receives that image URL.
Terraform apply, in the production environment, registers a new task definition and updates the service.
Fargate pulls the commit-SHA-tagged image from ECR.
Dashed lines: each job assuming the OIDC role.
Plan and apply keep Terraform state in an S3 backend.
A separate destroy workflow removes everything after a typed confirmation.
